Attached: 1 image

Plainva 0.8.3 is out for desktop, Android and iOS TestFlight.

Continue editing in the same conflict copy. Return to pinboards without reloading unchanged cards. Read with less clutter on mobile and open images at a larger size. Joplin imports preserve more structure and Obsidian task metadata is better supported, while HTML and mail inputs receive stricter checks.

All the changes since 0.8.2:
https://plainva.com/blog/plainva-0-8-3
